name: Kokuentouki Dark Shadow
original_name: 黒炎闘鬼ダーク・シャドー
source:
Evil organization "Eden" aims to conquer the world. It imbues main character with the ability to manipulate physical bodies and erases his memory. He boldly decides to fight "Eden" in order to recover his memories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
邪恶组织“伊甸”企图征服世界。
它赋予主人公操纵肉体的能力，同时抹去了他的记忆。
为了找回记忆，他毅然决定与“伊甸”战斗。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
